# Beta120 — alarm wake-up and reliable room sleep

- Select a next-alarm time/timestamp entity and a numeric minutes entity in
  General settings. HEM leaves automatic Sleep that many minutes before the
  alarm; 07:00 and 30 minutes resume normal targets at 06:30. Zero means at the
  alarm. Time-only helpers use Home Assistant's local timezone.
- Wake-up follows alarm and lead-time edits. After the alarm rings, the same
  sleep episode stays awake through phone rollover and reloads.
  Explicit presets, Manual control, Away behavior and existing device
  protections retain their priority.
- Fix overnight room occupancy: unchanged occupied/sleeping lists and binary
  presence states remain valid. Lists can come from the entity state or a
  selected attribute. Omitted rooms, all-Off presence inputs and rooms with no
  presence inputs are unoccupied; genuinely unavailable or malformed evidence
  can still be Unknown. Numeric occupancy counts retain freshness checks.
- Shared sleeping-room membership activates Sleep only for an occupied room.
  Room indicators use actual presence evidence instead of a controller's
  comfort assumption or vacancy delay.
- Add **Sleep · When everyone is sleeping** to every device controller. This
  optional setting applies household Sleep in Automatic/PID when at least one
  room is occupied and every occupied room is in the sleeping-room list. It is
  disabled by default and includes occupied rooms outside HEM's selected rooms.
- Keep General settings, translated labels, explanation bubbles and the README
  guide aligned with these rules. Device controls remain editable while offline.

The existing comfort algorithms and humidity defaults are retained. Regression
coverage includes overnight inputs, occupancy priority, alarm boundaries and
rollover, timezones, reload persistence, independent device choices, in-flight
commands, offline settings and timer rescheduling.

Update through HACS and restart Home Assistant. Configure the two alarm inputs
in General settings, then enable household Sleep on any devices that need it.
